content:
**A paused forge lane says so instead of loading, and a closed delta keeps a just-closed issue (#1262)**

1) readForge mapped any pending forgeLoad lane to 'loading open issues from the forge…', so brain:ui --no-poll read as loading forever. Now pendingLane() carries the lane reason with an additive idle:true flag on pending sections (D112/D113); report.mjs pendingFrom() propagates it to hierarchy and localWorktrees; banners.mjs splits loading vs idle bands ('not read yet, <reason>: <names>'). 2) poller publishClosed deleted lastOpenNumbers from closedHeld; a closed delta landing before the open list (own worker thread) dropped a just-closed issue until the next covering delta. Now it filters at publish time and never mutates closedHeld (self-heals). 3) forge-cache holdsAnyAnswer keys off the open list only (D115): a closed landing alone must not turn 'first poll has not completed' into 'queued'. Gotcha: poll:false server tests that inject vcs bypass forgeLoad; compose poll:false with the cache-backed snapshot.
